annotations.text: Three homepage directions. All three use the app's real tokens - navy #082e66, blue #075fb9, paper #faf9f6/#f3f2ee, Space Grotesk headings, Inter body, 9/12/18px radii. Pick one, or pick parts.
A - Drawn paper. Closest to the design you showed me: light ground, the ink drawing IS the hero, numbered pastel cards. Tradeoff: the photograph goes away.

B - Photograph + ink. Keeps the photo you asked me to restore, and lays the drawing over it in light ink along the bottom. Cyber Saathi is the big right-hand card. Tradeoff: drawing reads quieter over a dark photo.
C - Ask first. No scenery: the page opens by asking what happened, with four plain choices. Drawing sits in the margin. Tradeoff: less welcoming, much faster to act on.
